title: Reconcile examination closure with admission, reservation and transport
observation: A revoked examination closes a pulled movement and refunds capacity but retains its consuming admission.
recommendation: Reconcile real commitments atomically, preserving actual arrival/departure facts and an attributable exception path.

title: Guard operational actions against surviving commitments after stage correction
observation: Step-back then pull can create a second admission; step-back then withdrawal or release can orphan or remove a real commitment. Controls now exist locally.
recommendation: Keep correction separate from physical reversal. Guard later actions by reservation/admission IDs and physical milestones, not merely the stage.

title: Verify remaining high-acuity staffing at allocation
observation: Remaining high-acuity capacity is zero, but a non-overridden pull creates a second high-acuity occupant against capacity one.
recommendation: Enforce remaining high-acuity capacity with a specific refusal and the explicitly approved recorded-exception policy.

title: Separate cancellation, replacement booking and handover readiness
observation: Cancelling before handover creates a replacement at handover_ready; the job can collect without HANDOVER_READY ever being recorded.
recommendation: Separate cancellation, deliberate replacement and clinical readiness. A cancellation cannot prove readiness.

title: Define destination change and diversion after reservation or collection
observation: No complete diversion contract was verified. Stage rewriting is not a physical diversion event.
recommendation: Agree old/new bed accounting, amended transport and responsible service. Record actual diversion after collection rather than erasing departure.

title: Count one physical departure once across admission and bed-release paths
observation: Legacy departure plus anonymous release credits two vacancies for one recorded patient departure. No common turnover identity distinguishes duplicate entry from two real beds.
recommendation: Link one physical departure to one turnover. Preserve two credits for two genuinely different departures, but make retries and dual reporting idempotent.

title: Validate runtime events and define capacity reconciliation
observation: Capacity accepts negative, fractional, NaN, infinite and excessive values. An unknown step-back stage passes indexOf(-1).
recommendation: Validate finite integers, bounds, enums and IDs at the reducer boundary. This is not proof that the normal dropdown submits an invalid stage.

title: Prevent an old capacity draft overwriting a newer observation
observation: The real ward page changed confirmed capacity 1 to 0 after Pull, left draft 1, then restored 1 when Confirm capacity was clicked untouched.
recommendation: Use draft/source revisions, refresh clean drafts and require explicit reconciliation for stale dirty drafts. Preserve the browser sequence as a regression.

title: Preserve patient/referral provenance and intended-episode uniqueness
observation: Local admissions now copy linked patientId. referralId and homeRegion remain null; this is not complete episode provenance.
recommendation: Carry verified identifiers, explicit unknowns and episode/idempotency keys. Do not infer identity from names or location.

title: Deliver recipient-scoped notices that survive active-row removal
observation: The entire delivery and acknowledgement chain for every removed/withdrawn row was not traced. A central audit is not proof of recipient notification.
recommendation: Verify each sending/receiving route after row removal and navigation, including unauthorised readers. Do not claim every notice is absent.

title: Make parallel-referral add, replace and withdraw semantics explicit
observation: Active destination replacement and historic decisions are different facts. Adding B must not ambiguously withdraw A or revive a declined request.
recommendation: Choose explicit add/replace/withdraw operations and verify both recipient views, re-referral and parallel limits.

title: Complete community decisions and independent referral purposes
observation: Community decline exists locally. Community acceptance is not permitted. ED acceptance can leave a community purpose queued but not decidable even by coordinator.
recommendation: Separate independent destination-purpose lifecycles from aggregate acceptance. Agree the community acceptance actor and test both decision orders.

title: Make front-door withdrawal terminal for pending decisions
observation: A withdrawn destination can subsequently be accepted or declined while retaining withdrawnAt.
recommendation: Make withdrawal terminal for that attempt. A new intentional referral must be distinct, with visible refusal of stale decisions.

title: Provide truthful all-declined and no-admission exits
observation: No complete resolution path was established for every no-destination, all-declined or no-admission state.
recommendation: Provide outcome, re-referral and escalation choices, retaining a responsible service until accepted handover or documented closure.

title: Represent direct community/ward origins and inter-ward transfers
observation: ED-only origin is not a truthful direct community or inter-ward transfer, despite widened booking roles.
recommendation: Model typed sender/location and source admission. Distinguish inter-ward transfer from discharge to community and scope sender permissions.

title: Complete a no-booked-transport-needed journey
observation: Transport need false can be recorded, but handover readiness still demands a booking.
recommendation: Support an assessed no-provider-booking path with appropriate readiness, departure and receiving confirmation. Do not create a fictional job.

title: Allow reassessment and changing clinical decisions
observation: A later assessment must not be confused with correction or with safe resource closure.
recommendation: Record superseding assessments and their consequences without rewriting history. Test changing admission, physical health, escort and legal requirements.

title: Complete discharge dependencies and accountable community follow-up
observation: Protected discharge, scoped readers and stale/replay protection now work. They do not establish complete EDD, barrier, receiving-service and clinical follow-up workflows.
recommendation: Keep new guards; connect planning, actual departure, accepted follow-up task and clinically relevant contact. Scheduling alone is not clinical contact.

title: Connect temporary ED attendance to named location and responsible service
observation: An away-at-ED flag and timestamp do not alone identify the ED encounter or responsible receiving service.
recommendation: Link source admission, receiving ED/location and responsibility; cover return, medical admission and non-return without duplicate stock.

title: Link leave-bed handling to an admission and leave episode
observation: Unit-level leave-bed entries do not uniquely establish the person/leave episode whose return must be handled.
recommendation: Add admission and leave identities with an approved holding rule. Test overlapping leave, early/late return and non-return.

title: Agree reservation expiry and handover snapshot semantics
observation: Expired reservation display does not itself authorise release. Frozen handover and live state answer different questions.
recommendation: Agree expiry escalation/renewal/release and distinguish immutable snapshot time from live state, including collected patients and midnight.

title: Render or clear a closed coordinator selection coherently
observation: A later selected-movement lookup does not itself exclude closed records, but retaining a read-only history view could be intentional. No crash reproduced.
recommendation: Prove either clear-and-return-focus or explicit closed read-only detail across another role's closure, Back/Forward and navigation.

title: Avoid accepted cases appearing as declined by all
observation: Decline A, refer B, accept B still enters handover declined_by_all because the predicate ignores acceptedUnitId.
recommendation: Use current acceptance/unresolved requests, not historical decline count, while retaining the historic decision.

title: Preserve the intended date in time-only inputs
observation: HH:MM parses to day-zero 0-1439 and cannot express the intended later day. The comments claiming it always matches now are false after day zero.
recommendation: Use date plus time or an explicit day selection, verify stored instants and printed labels at midnight and on later days.

title: Separate occurrence, recording, update and verification times
status: Native helper semantics plus source concern
observation: 39 hours ahead is classified as tomorrow despite rolling-24-hour prose. Mutable confirmation time should not substitute for departure occurrence.
recommendation: Choose calendar versus rolling horizon explicitly and separate occurrence/update/freshness timestamps. A note update must not create a new discharge.

title: Verify physical consistency of the scarce scenario
observation: Scarce has gry-older-adult allocatable 1 but empty 0. Standard seed has no allocatable-above-empty case.
recommendation: Repair or explicitly define the fixture semantics and keep zero physical vacancy unambiguous. Test actual allocation boundaries.

title: Verify replacement Capacity and Delays controls
observation: Capacity renders at desktop/phone. Its facade mock omits worldGeneration and causes a null dereference not seen with the real provider. Full revised controls remain unexhausted.
recommendation: Fix the mock contract, then test real routed filtering, selection, empty groups and Delays. Do not label the mock crash a proven app crash.

title: Resolve Morning frozen-versus-live contract
observation: Morning still redirects to bare Capacity; as-at-morning behaviour is explicitly unimplemented.
recommendation: Implement a real frozen view or formally retire that requirement. Do not invent a decorative query parameter.

title: Establish privacy and genuine service-scoped authority
observation: Declared prototype roles and scoped readers are not authenticated server authorisation. No penetration test or actual data breach was established.
recommendation: Establish identity, service membership, server enforcement, least privilege, access audit and retention before real data.

title: Govern sensitive demographic display and decision use
observation: A sensitive demographic adjacency guard fails. This is not proof of a discriminatory allocation outcome.
recommendation: Inspect the actual patient layout and decision use with approved culturally safe semantics, keyboard order and purpose/provenance.

title: Validate legal forms, authority and deadline provenance
observation: Legal status, form validity, location/transport authority and operational targets must not be collapsed. Product override is not legal authority.
recommendation: Version authoritative rules, verify supported transitions and clocks with clinical/legal owners, and keep operational deadlines distinct.

title: Agree ranking, urgency and waiting-time policy
observation: Clinical ordering and fairness were not recertified by this audit; an operational score is not statewide optimality proof.
recommendation: Use clinician-reviewed cases, defined tie-breaking, override accountability and starvation checks. Avoid sensitive proxies.

title: Provide authoritative persistence, concurrency and recovery
observation: Session-local reducer/audit state does not prove durable multi-user stock or audit history.
recommendation: Add approved authoritative persistence, concurrency, idempotency and recovery. Test two real clients on an isolated backend, not unrelated reducers.

title: Make tests discriminate actual workflow failures
observation: 462 files ran with 5045 pass,135 fail,75 pending. Later 56-file rerun:838 pass,96 fail. Literal wording, stale selectors and incomplete mocks coexist with real contracts.
recommendation: Triage product, design, oracle, fixture and environment separately. Preserve negative/positive controls and rerun the full population on a stable tree.

title: Align architecture notes with current code
observation: Unqualified engine-sound/pass-count claims and several historical comments lag the code. Installed Next 16.3.3 DOES supply retry.
recommendation: Use dated receipts and current contracts. Do not reverse valid retry wiring or new routes based on stale prose.

title: Require an actually ready resource of the appropriate kind
observation: In 27 resource states, zero empty with positive allocatable and no pending preparation permits pull.
recommendation: Guard actual physical readiness independently of pending preparation and eligibility. Preserve the separately approved display arithmetic.

title: Reconcile the booked job when releasing its reservation
observation: Book, release pull, cancel, collect, arrive can close a movement and decrement empty beds without an admission.
recommendation: Bind transport to reservation/admission and account for job disposition on release. Use diversion after collection, not a fake reversal.

title: Retain applied override reasons consistently across projections
status: Old missing-reason claim refuted in part
observation: New audit retains the selected pull override reason. Legacy movement.overrides gains no entry and audit says overrideFactRecorded=false.
recommendation: Do not add duplicate logging. Reconcile the canonical applied-override projection, legacy counts and flag semantics, proving exact reason/subject once.

title: Treat valid zero timestamps as present
observation: A monotonic journey accepted at instant0 cannot go en route at1 and accepts a duplicate acceptance at2.
recommendation: Use explicit timestamp presence checks, cover zero/negative/undefined/positive values and milestone retries.

title: Tie preparation to a current turnover identity
observation: Unit-level discharged/preparing records cannot themselves distinguish an unresolved old cycle from a current turnover.
recommendation: Link bed and turnover, retain historical notes and test delayed old-cycle updates. Do not expire real unfinished work automatically.

title: Decide which ward entries become shared facts
observation: Several confirmations/constraints are local. Current labels acknowledge page scope; the old never-answered allegation is not retained.
recommendation: Classify local acknowledgement versus shared observation versus history, with provenance/retention that matches the label.

title: Separate transport arrival from receipt and responsibility
observation: Officer arrival/occupancy is not the receiving clinical team's handover acknowledgement.
recommendation: Record both physical arrival and explicit receiving responsibility, preserving an accountable exception path when they do not coincide.

title: Provide change-sensitive readiness and owned recovery
observation: Readiness can become stale after clinical, legal, escort or destination changes. Not every recovery scenario was executed.
recommendation: Link readiness to the facts assessed, record reassessment and owner, and permit truthful physical event recording with explicit exceptions.

title: Maintain verified service and catchment directory
observation: No complete WA directory or live staffed-bed recertification was performed in this audit.
recommendation: Maintain source authority, dates, scope, contacts and uncertainty. Do not treat hospital totals as current suitable staffed ward capacity.

title: Scope regional multi-leg transport and repatriation
observation: A single ED-origin/job path is not a full regional multi-leg retrieval or repatriation workflow.
recommendation: Model legs, connecting handovers and responsible services when included. Do not delay current integrity fixes for optional future scope.

title: Establish clinical safety ownership and controlled pilot
observation: A large suite and source audit are not clinical validation, regulatory classification or deployment approval.
recommendation: Maintain hazard ownership, exclusions, human oversight, downtime/rollback and clinician-led acceptance evidence.

title: Define truthful flow analytics and measure benefit
observation: Invalid identity, stock and timestamps can produce plausible wrong metrics.
recommendation: Define population/denominator/occurrence time/missingness and reconcile event records to every outcome metric before claiming benefit.

title: Maintain capability register and evidence-bound backlog
observation: 48 old rows mix bugs, decisions and gates. 52 snapshotted files changed while four core modules remained unchanged.
recommendation: Keep stable IDs, maturity labels, hashes, evidence and closure proof. A changed core invalidates its old proof; unrelated visual changes do not.

title: Give community screens truthful role and task context
observation: Chrome has no community role and defaults its context to coordinator, differing from actual community reducer permissions.
recommendation: Add truthful community or neutral context and verify role label, primary action and tasks without accidentally widening permissions.

title: Remove unproved aggregate placement guarantee
observation: Equal counts in four broad bed groups do not prove nobody goes without today given individual constraints.
recommendation: Say nominal category capacity/gap, not guaranteed placement. Test equal totals with incompatible needs.

title: Stabilise local server/cache verification safely
observation: Normal Turbopack startup failed on missing SST files. Isolated cache worked. The first board chunk error did not recur in two later visits.
recommendation: Keep environment and app findings separate, verify identity/free managed port, preserve logs and never delete another session's cache.
